predecessors.name: Northern Liang
predecessors.text: Loulan (Shanshan) and Gaochang in 442, the year of the exile's two conquests

successors.name: Kingdom of Gaochang
successors.text: Gaochang, 'the oasis city of Gaochang' (Northern Liang page), drawn as a 120 km disc as in the kingdom-of-gaochang dossier

ledger.x: 444: Wuhui dies and Anzhou becomes Prince of Hexi.
460: the Rouran destroy the Juqu regime.

wars.name: Juqu conquest of Loulan and Gaochang
wars.outcome: Anzhou invaded Loulan in spring 442 and its king fled to Cherchen; Wuhui left Dunhuang and took Gaochang in the fall.

wars.name: Rouran conquest of Gaochang
wars.outcome: The Rouran killed Juqu Anzhou and his clan and installed Kan Bozhou as King of Gaochang.

certainty.note: A refugee regime on an oasis: no boundary on any page; Gaochang is a disc.
